Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 13
Reason for Mistake: The Planner made a critical logical error in comparing the birth dates of the two directors. The conversation established that T. V. Chandran was born in 1950 and Julia Crawford Ivers was born in 1869 (or 1867). The Planner incorrectly concluded that Julia Crawford Ivers was born "later" than T. V. Chandran, stating "standardized to 1967 places her birth later than 1950." This is a fundamental misunderstanding of chronological order; 1869 is significantly earlier than 1950, not later. The error stems from a failure to correctly interpret the numerical values of the birth years retrieved in previous steps, leading to an incorrect final conclusion.
